summary: Implemented the simpy 4.x core under src/simpy: the Environment scheduler, run/step, BoundClass binding, Event/Timeout/Process/Interruption/Condition and ConditionValue, Interrupt.cause, the Resource, PriorityResource and PreemptiveResource put/get logic, Container, Store, PriorityStore and FilterStore, the RealtimeEnvironment step, and the start_delayed and subscribe_at helpers. The last full-suite run gave 149 passed and 1 failed; the failure is tests/test_version.py because the simpy distribution metadata is not installed here, so simpy.__version__ is never set.
